summary: Verification pass after alternate-route manual switcher + race-condition fix. All backend contract endpoints (root, overview, reports, vehicles/{id}/route valid + invalid) and all frontend flows (dashboard load, metrics, state filter, role filter, language toggle EN<->AS, bottleneck panel, field report toast + persisted risk bump, alternate-route switcher disabled/enabled state + toast + persisted route change, and 35s auto-refresh) passed without regressions.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /api/vehicles/{id}/route returns HTTP 200 with {ok:false} for invalid vehicle/route. Frontend contract-friendly but violates REST semantics; consider 404/400 with structured error in future.

App.js is one very dense JSX file (~50 LOC, but everything on line 36 is ~4KB). Fine for the demo; if scope grows, split Map, RouteSwitcher, FieldReportModal, VehicleTable into components for readability.

In-memory state means the demo drifts monotonically (risk saturates at 98, incidents grow, all Assam vehicles get status=rerouted once any Assam report is filed). Consider a POST /api/reset endpoint to snap back to fixtures for repeat demos.
Dev-mode console noise: `<span>` injected into `<option>` by Emergent instrumentation causes a hydration warning. Not our code and does not affect UX, but the demo console will show a red warning.
seed_data_creation: None persistent. Test runs mutated the in-memory Assam route (risk saturated at 98) and V-021's route (now NH-2 / Imphal–Moreh, status=rerouted). Any subsequent demo should be preceded by a backend restart to reset to fixtures.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend routes now include 5 alternate routes (`is_alternate:true`) so the previous strict `len(routes)==7` assertion has been relaxed to `>=7` and an `is_alternate` presence check has been added. Vehicles carry `route_options` populated from live routes list per state. requestVersion race guard confirmed working (post-submit toast is not clobbered by in-flight /overview). Switcher wiring: `route-vehicle-select`, `alternate-route-select`, `switch-route-button` — button starts disabled and enables only after picking an alternate. Toast messages: report → '<route> risk increased to N — 2 vehicles rerouted'; switch → '<VID> switched to <route>'.
rca of the issue: No defects reproduced. Previous stale assertion `len(routes)==7` was outdated after the alternate-routes feature (backend now ships 12 routes: 7 primary + 5 alternate). Test relaxed to `>=7` and verified alternates exist.
